title: Birational comparison on the codimension induction bad locus
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite field $B$ of characteristic $\ell$, and an integer $c\geq1$. For a Noetherian scheme $Z$, write $\operatorname{ht}_Z(z)=\dim\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ and say that a closed subset has codimension at least $a$ when every point in it has height at least $a$; the empty closed subset has every codimension. Assume the following induction hypothesis: for every Noetherian quasi-excellent scheme $Z$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, every open immersion $v:V\hookrightarrow Z$, and every $L\in D^b_c(V_{\mathrm{et}},B)$, there is a closed subset $C\subseteq Z$ of codimension at least $c$ such that $(Rv_*L)|_{Z\setminus C}$ is bounded constructible. Let $X$ be integral Noetherian quasi-excellent with $\ell$ invertible, let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a dense open immersion, let $K\in D^b_c(U_{\mathrm{et}},B)$, and let $T\subseteq X$ be an integral reduced closed subscheme with generic point $t$ of height $c$, such that $Rj_*K$ is bounded constructible on $X\setminus T$. Let $p:X'\to X$ be a proper morphism of integral schemes, an isomorphism over some dense open of $X$, and let $(e_i:E_i\to X')$ be a finite completely decomposed family of separated finite-type etale morphisms (every point of $X'$ lifts with the same residue field). Put $U'=U\times_XX'$, let $j':U'\hookrightarrow X'$ be its inclusion, and set $K'=p_U^*K$. After restricting $X$ to some open neighbourhood of $t$ and base changing all these data, there is a reduced closed subscheme $T'=\coprod_{\alpha}T'_\alpha\subseteq X'$, a finite disjoint union of integral subschemes, each finite and surjective over $T$, such that $Rj'_*K'$ is bounded constructible on $X'\setminus T'$. For every $\alpha$, some $e_{i_\alpha}$ has a section $s_\alpha:T'_\alpha\to E_{i_\alpha}$ over $X'$. If $i:T\hookrightarrow X$ and $i':T'\hookrightarrow X'$ are the inclusions and $p_T:T'\to T$ is induced by $p$, the composite of the base-change unit and restriction,
$$i^*Rj_*K\longrightarrow R(p_T)_*i'^*Rj'_*K',$$
has a cone in $D^b_c(T_{\mathrm{et}},B)$. The finite family of components of $T'$ is allowed to be empty. The scheme and coefficient notions are [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; local ring dimension means Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
